description: This PHP class OAuthCodeGrantManager manages OAuth2 authorization request sessions, including saving, loading, validation, and cleanup of session data related to OAuth2 authorization code grants.

classes.name: OAuthCodeGrantManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing OAuth2 authorization code grant sessions within the SuiteCRM environment, including saving, retrieving, and validating authorization requests.

methods.name: saveRequestToSession
methods.description: Saves OAuth2 authorization request details into the PHP session, including response type, client ID, redirect URI, scope, and challenge parameters, along with process metadata.

methods.name: loadAuthorizationRequest
methods.description: Loads an OAuth2 authorization request from the session, validates the session data, and creates a corresponding AuthorizationRequest object with user information.

methods.name: cleanupSession
methods.description: Removes OAuth2-related session variables, cleaning up after the authorization process.

methods.name: validateConfirmationRequest
methods.description: Validates that the incoming request confirms to a valid OAuth2 authorization flow by checking session and request parameters, throwing exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: getQueryParam
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve specific query parameters from the request object, with support for default values.
